description: One 18-inch crash from a licensed private local sample corpus.

source_metadata.capture_policy: Render through the licensed local engine with all five requested articulations loaded and hit variation enabled. Disable adjacent layers, alternate hits, velocity-to-volume, cymbal smoothing, timing/velocity randomization, and internal processing. Do not redistribute source audio.
source_metadata.private_metadata_policy: Exact vendor, product, instrument, and local path metadata belongs in an ignored local companion manifest, not this public manifest.

capture.channel_policy: Fit the unprocessed overhead mid channel first; retain close and room exports as held-out observation views.
capture.gain: unchanged; no peak, RMS, or loudness normalization

excluded_from_primary_fit: Crescendo: a performed roll rather than one common hit event
Mute hit and mute tail: reserved for the passive-mute validation pass
FX: not part of the neutral articulation grid
held_out_validation: Two independent licensed 18-inch crash velocity sweeps
Salamander ride2 crash MP/FF repeated takes
VCSL suspended-cymbal stick and mallet dynamics
